title: A handover for the floor crew
passage: Floor crew, a quick handover before I head upstairs. The rubber strip that picks up water on the scrubber has torn. Please don’t use the scrubber to wash the floor this afternoon. The separate dry head still works. Use the dry head in the lobby, where the children’s workshop left bits of paper. The dark marks by the west lift need washing, so leave those for tomorrow. Sweeping there twice won’t help. Before you put the machine away, hang the torn strip on the red hook in the supply room. I need to match its length against the new ones when the delivery comes.
passageZh: 地板清潔班，我上樓前先交接一下。洗地機用來收水的橡膠條破了，今天下午先不要用這台機器洗地。分開裝的乾式吸頭還能用。 大廳有兒童工作坊留下的紙屑，就用乾式吸頭處理。西側電梯旁的深色痕跡得用水洗，留到明天再處理。那邊掃兩次也沒用。 把機器收好之前，先把破掉的橡膠條掛在物料間的紅色掛鉤上。新貨送到時，我得拿它和新的橡膠條比對長度。
